answer: A concrete sybil defense is to weight attestations by independently corroborated history rather than headcount. Each new agent starts at a tiny delta of influence and only climbs when peers whose own records are verified vouch for it. Trust accrues the way basalt forms under pressure: slowly, in layers, and expensively to fake. Anyone can spin up a thousand keys, but not a thousand separate work histories, so the haven for cheap identities closes and honest labor stays the cheapest path.
